title: Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran Wedding Reportedly Set for November 2026
excerpt: Music composer's uncle confirms the union, with reports pointing to a destination ceremony in Spain and grand Chennai reception after Jailer 2 release
body:
• Veteran actor Y Gee Mahendra, Anirudh Ravichander's uncle, has publicly confirmed that the music composer and Sunrisers Hyderabad CEO Kavya Maran are set to marry.
  • Multiple reports indicate the wedding is planned for the second week of November 2026, shortly after the October 15 release of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2.
  • The ceremony is reportedly being planned as a destination wedding in Spain, followed by a large-scale reception in Chennai.
  • Neither Anirudh nor Kavya has officially commented on the wedding plans, though the couple has reportedly been together since 2024.

What was once South India's most persistent rumour now appears to be heading toward reality. Multiple reports and a family confirmation point to music composer Anirudh Ravichander and Sunrisers Hyderabad CEO Kavya Maran tying the knot in November 2026, in what would be one of the most high-profile weddings at the intersection of Indian entertainment and cricket.

Uncle's Confirmation Breaks Months of Silence

The clearest signal came in late June 2026, when veteran actor and dramatist Y Gee Mahendra — Anirudh's maternal uncle — spoke about the couple during an interview with Kutty Padmini's KPTV channel.

https://x.com/MissMalini/status/2089608047618580762

"From what I've heard, they are going to get married. That girl is not just another ordinary girl. She has the capacity to handle such a big team. She has inherited her father's business genes. They're a good pair."

— Y Gee Mahendra, actor and Anirudh's uncle

Mahendra's comments marked the first concrete familial acknowledgement of the relationship, which Anirudh himself had dismissed as "mere rumours" just a year earlier. In June 2025, the composer had posted on X: "Marriage ah? lol .. Chill out guys pls stop spreading rumours," after a viral Reddit thread alleged he and Kavya were dating.

The shift from public denial to a family member's on-camera confirmation has only intensified media and fan interest.

November Timeline, Spain Venue

According to Tamil entertainment channel Valai Pechu, the wedding is expected in the second week of November 2026. The timing is deliberate — it falls after the October 15 worldwide release of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2, for which Anirudh has composed the music.

Reports from Filmibeat Tamil and LatestLY indicate that families on both sides have finalized arrangements for a destination wedding in Spain, followed by a grand reception in Chennai for friends, colleagues, and dignitaries from the entertainment and business worlds.

Neither Anirudh nor Kavya has officially confirmed the date, venue, or any wedding details as of mid-August 2026.

Where Entertainment Meets Cricket Royalty

The pairing brings together two of South India's most prominent young figures from different but overlapping worlds.

Anirudh Ravichander, 35, is arguably the most in-demand film composer in India right now. Born into a family steeped in cinema — his father Ravi Raghavendra is an actor, his mother Lakshmi is a classical dancer, and superstar Rajinikanth is his uncle by marriage — Anirudh burst onto the national stage at 21 with "Why This Kolaveri Di" from the 2012 Tamil film 3. The song became a global viral phenomenon, racking up over 590 million YouTube views.

Since then, he has composed chart-topping soundtracks for films starring Rajinikanth (Jailer, Petta), Vijay (Kaththi, Master, Leo), Kamal Haasan (Vikram), and made his Bollywood debut with Shah Rukh Khan's blockbuster Jawan in 2023. His current slate includes Vijay's swansong Jana Nayagan, Rajinikanth's Jailer 2, and Shah Rukh Khan's King.

Kavya Maran, 33, is the daughter of media mogul Kalanithi Maran, chairman of the Sun Group, which controls Sun TV Network, one of India's largest media conglomerates. She serves as CEO and co-owner of the IPL franchise Sunrisers Hyderabad and oversees the Sun Group's expanding cricket portfolio — Sunrisers Eastern Cape in South Africa's SA20 League and Sunrisers Leeds in England's The Hundred. She also holds the position of Executive Director at Sun TV Network Limited.

Her animated reactions during IPL matches have made her one of the tournament's most recognizable faces, regularly trending on social media during the cricket season.

A Merger of Two South Indian Dynasties

Beyond the personal milestone, the union effectively ties together two powerful South Indian dynasties. The Maran family's Sun Group is a media and entertainment empire spanning television, film production (Sun Pictures), and professional cricket across three countries. Anirudh's extended family includes Rajinikanth — Tamil cinema's biggest star — through his aunt Latha Rajinikanth.

The overlap is already professional: Sun Pictures has produced several films featuring Anirudh's compositions, including Petta and Jailer. A marriage would deepen a relationship between the two families that has already shaped Tamil entertainment for over a decade.

With Jailer 2's October release likely to be one of the year's biggest box office events and a wedding reportedly weeks later, the final months of 2026 are shaping up to be a landmark period for both Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran — and for the South Indian entertainment world watching closely.
nri_angle: High-profile South Indian entertainment-cricket crossover wedding between Anirudh Ravichander, India's top film composer and Rajinikanth's nephew, and Kavya Maran, CEO of IPL franchise Sunrisers Hyderabad and daughter of Sun Group chairman Kalanithi Maran
